biography:
I have seventeen years experience preparing project cost estimates for Higher Education, Healthcare, Commercial Mixed Use, DoD Facilities, Heavy Industrial, Power Generation and DoE Nuclear Facilities. These estimates covered all major contract structures from Lump Sum to Cost Plus to GMP. I've included a list of major job duties and skills in my acumen below.

• Practices and promotes culture of safety awareness on jobsite and in office.
• Significant knowledge regarding construction methods and materials.
• Prepares estimates for Lump Sum, Design-Build and Guaranteed Maximum Price contract strategies
• Experience preparing cost estimates valuing $0.5MM - $2B.
• Reviews contract, plans and specifications and participates in bid Go/No-Go decision meetings with project management.
• Develops proposal schedule, staffing plan and budget.
• Participates in development of project subcontracting strategy with project management.
• Normalizes bids and prepares subcontractor comparison materials for project management team to review
• Composes estimate basis memorandum narrative.
• Responsible for ensuring compliant, correct and on time submittal of bid documents.
• Assists in development and review of project budgets and cash flows
• Develops and leads oral and visual estimate review presentations for executive and client audiences
• Experience with review and development of various project plans including: execution, subcontract, staffing and procurement plans.
• Prepares or assists in formatting and composition of technical documentation supporting Estimate. 
• Establishes and maintains cost databases and specific parametric analysis tools.
• Mentors and assists in development of Junior Estimators
